purpose: Reference research only. These are competitor list prices, not approved Folio selling prices, supplier agreements, availability or product certifications.

packit.pk.pricing: PKR. Stock packaging list prices generally per piece. Plain jars and bottles exclude labels. Custom printing is separately quoted; shipping and taxes may be extra. Collection starting prices do not always match the selected variant.

instaprint.pk.pricing: Many custom products show Rs0/out-of-stock alongside WhatsApp quote prompts. Several quick-option widgets show prices without quantity/specification. Do not treat zero as free or ambiguous values as confirmed print prices.

uxRecommendations: Shop by purpose before technical box structure: launch a brand, food delivery, gifts, business print, apparel.
Separate ready-size plain stock from customized printing; show included decoration explicitly.
Show PKR per piece or per pack alongside selected dimensions and quantity; show total immediately.
Provide category chips, search, filters and an obvious reset/no-results state.
Use short product cards with a clean visual and one meaningful specification.
Offer3D customization only for supported box and apparel templates; other products get an artwork/specification brief.
Keep quote requests together in a saved list; one clear download/share brief without pretending payment or order placement occurred.
Do not import competitors' ratings, promises, client logos, delivery times, food certifications or contacts into Folio.
